text: おっと　にもつが　いっぱいだね　また　あとで　あげよう！

structure.jp: にもつが　いっぱいだね
structure.en: your bag is full, isn't it

structure.jp: また　あとで　あげよう！
structure.en: I'll give it to you again later!

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: The よう ending on a verb says the speaker has decided to do it: 'I'll do it'. あとで あげよう = 'I'll give it to you later'.
